name: URL Parser / Builder
summary: Parse URLs into components or build a URL from protocol, host, path, query, and hash.
description: Paste any URL to see protocol, hostname, port, path, query parameters, hash, and auth parts. Switch to Build mode to compose a URL from fields, or send a parsed URL to the builder for editing.

faqs.question: What if I paste a URL without https://?
faqs.answer: Bare hostnames get https:// prepended automatically for parsing (e.g. example.com/path).

faqs.question: Are credentials shown?
faqs.answer: Usernames are shown in plain text. Passwords are masked in the parse view but included when building URLs.

faqs.question: Is my URL sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Parsing and building run entirely in your browser.
